_comment: Bucket lifecycle for campusnotehub-c3957.firebasestorage.app.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AND IS NOT PART OF `firebase deploy`
Object lifecycle and versioning are GCS bucket settings, not Firebase
Storage settings. `firebase.json` has no field for them and the Firebase
CLI has no command that sets them, so they are applied with gcloud or the
Cloud console. Keeping the intended state here means it is reviewable in
code review and reproducible after a bucket is recreated, instead of
living only in one operator's shell history.
APPLY WITH:
gcloud storage buckets update gs://campusnotehub-c3957.firebasestorage.app \
--lifecycle-file=firebase/storage.lifecycle.json
gcloud storage buckets update gs://campusnotehub-c3957.firebasestorage.app \
--no-versioning
VERIFY WITH:
gcloud storage buckets describe gs://campusnotehub-c3957.firebasestorage.app \
--format='value(lifecycle_config,versioning_enabled)'
WHY 8 DAYS AND NOT 7
The review buffer's own TTL is REVIEW_BUFFER_TTL_SECONDS, 7 days, and it
is enforced twice in application code: retrieve() refuses and destroys an
expired buffer on the read path, and the scheduler's reapExpired() sweeps
and closes the cases. This rule is the THIRD layer - the backstop for an
object both of those missed.
A backstop must never fire early. GCS `age` is measured in whole days and
the lifecycle scan is asynchronous, so 7 could delete a buffer that still
has hours of legitimate review window left - which would destroy a
moderator's evidence mid-review. 8 gives a full day of margin and still
bounds retention tightly. Raising this above the application TTL is safe;
lowering it to 7 or below is not.
WHY VERSIONING MUST BE OFF
Versioning keeps 'deleted' objects recoverable as noncurrent versions. For
the kyc-review/ prefix that would silently defeat every deletion path in
reviewBuffer.ts and break the retention promise the product makes. There
is no per-prefix versioning setting in GCS - it is bucket-wide - so the
bucket that holds kyc-review/ must have it off entirely.
SCOPE: this rule matches the kyc-review/ prefix ONLY. Notes, post media
and avatars are durable user content and are deliberately untouched.
